title: PWM Timer Synchronization and Phase Locking

c.v: The PWM modules adopt a flexible synchronization method.
Each PWM timer has a synchronization input and a synchronization output.
The synchronization input can be selected from three synchronization outputs and three synchronization signals from the GPIO matrix.
The synchronization output can be generated from the synchronization input signal, when the PWM timer's value is equal to period or zero, or software synchronization.
Thus, the PWM timers can be chained together with their phase locked.
During synchronization, the PWM timer clock prescaler will reset its counter in order to synchronize the PWM timer clock.
